style: A flat, decorative Persian folk painting in gouache for a collectible card game, like a modern naive Persian miniature: clean dark outlines, flat areas of rich colour with only gentle shading, a warm saffron-orange and golden-yellow painted ground with small round gold dots scattered over it, fabrics patterned with tiny white five-petal blossoms, wings drawn as stylised layered bands of feathers in deep green, rust-orange and slate-blue with white edges, long flowing lapis-blue ribbon sashes curling through the scene, flowering almond branches with pink blossoms, and small indigo-blue birds. Serene round faces with dark almond eyes, arched brows and small gentle smiles. Warm, joyful, gentle and kid-friendly, never scary, never realistic, never 3D. One clear main subject, centred and fully in frame. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, borders, card frames or watermarks.

subjects.PR1-H01-kitten: the cutest pari of all: a small pari girl, about eight years old in looks, with a round face, rosy cheeks, big dark almond eyes, black hair in two long braids, a little red-and-gold crown of tiny flowers, a red robe patterned with small white blossoms and a lapis-blue sash tied at the waist with long curling ends, bare feet, and a pair of wings much too big for her, layered in deep green, rust-orange and slate-blue feathers. She sits on a blossoming almond branch, swinging her bare feet, holding a white narcissus flower up to her nose with both hands and smiling with her eyes closed, while a small indigo-blue bird perches on the tip of one of her big wings. Tender, sweet, captivating. Not an angel, no halo, no glow.
subjects.PR1-H01-bigcat: the cutest pari of all: a small pari girl, about eight years old in looks, with a round face, rosy cheeks, big dark almond eyes, black hair in two long braids, a little red-and-gold crown of tiny flowers, a red robe patterned with small white blossoms and a lapis-blue sash tied at the waist with long curling ends, bare feet, and a pair of wings much too big for her, layered in deep green, rust-orange and slate-blue feathers. Now she flies high and proud, wings spread wide, her blue sash streaming behind her in long curls, a narcissus in her hand, laughing. Far below her is the rim of Mount Qaf, a flat stylised emerald-green mountain, and three white doves fly with her. Not an angel, no halo, no glow.
subjects.PR1-D02: an Orange-Peri from a Turkish fairy tale: a tiny pari no taller than a teacup, stepping out of a halved orange like a cradle, with little rust-orange wings, a pale orange robe with white blossoms and a green leaf for a cap. She holds out a tiny empty cup with both hands, asking for water, looking up hopefully. A small blue jug of water stands beside the orange.
subjects.PR1-D18: Manar al-Sana, the bird-maiden from the Thousand and One Nights: a graceful young pari woman with long black hair, lifting off from the stone edge of a round blue pool as she pulls on a shimmering cloak made entirely of white and slate-blue feathers, which turns into wings at her shoulders. A lapis-blue sash curls around her. Her face is joyful. Two white doves rise with her. A cypress tree stands beside the pool.
subjects.PR1-D20: Schaibar, the brother of the pari Pari Banu, from the Thousand and One Nights: a comically tiny, stout, fierce-looking but lovable dwarf, only a foot and a half tall, with a fluffy black beard so long it trails behind him in big curls across the ground, bushy eyebrows, a small green turban, a red coat with white blossoms, and a heavy iron bar resting on his shoulder, much bigger than he is. He stands with his chest puffed out and a proud grumpy frown. Funny, not scary.
subjects.PR1-D01: a pari's magic, told in one clear picture: a single white dove with a tiny red-and-gold crown on its head flies joyfully upwards, and just below it an empty red robe patterned with small white blossoms and a lapis-blue sash floats gently down through the air, left behind, with a few loose white feathers drifting around it. Only one creature in the picture: the dove. No people, no faces other than the dove's.
subjects.PR1-D03: Murghatipi, the bird fairy of the Chitral mountains: a small, lively bird-like fairy girl with a tuft of feathers for hair, bright round eyes, a short rust-orange cape of feathers and slate-blue wings, darting fast through the air past a snowy mountain peak, mischievous and quick.
subjects.PR1-D04: a pari: a winged young woman of Persian folk tales with a serene round face, dark almond eyes, long black hair, a red robe patterned with small white blossoms, a lapis-blue sash with long curling ends, bare feet, and big wings layered in deep green, rust-orange and slate-blue feathers, sitting at the stone edge of a round blue bathing pool with her bare feet in the water, her wings folded, turning her head and smiling as she hears her sisters call. Two more paris fly overhead, small in the distance. Water lilies and a cypress tree.
subjects.PR1-D05: a pari of the high mountain lakes, drawn half see-through like mist, flying low over a small turquoise lake between snowy peaks, her long sash and hair streaming as she blows a gust of wind from her lips; stylised curling wind lines and flying leaves around her, the lake rippling.
subjects.PR1-D06: a mountain fairy (súči) of the Hindu Kush: a sturdy, kind young fairy spirit with wings of grey and brown feathers and a simple dark woollen cloak with a plain embroidered hem, crouching on a rock and pointing the way for a hunter, a small bow over her shoulder. Warm, helpful, respectful.
subjects.PR1-D07: a proud markhor, the wild mountain goat with long corkscrew horns and a shaggy beard, leaping between rocks on a mountainside, with a small pari riding on its back holding one horn and laughing. Stylised flat rocks and a few alpine flowers.
subjects.PR1-D08: a pari: a winged young woman of Persian folk tales with a serene round face, dark almond eyes, long black hair, a red robe patterned with small white blossoms, a lapis-blue sash with long curling ends, bare feet, and big wings layered in deep green, rust-orange and slate-blue feathers, riding a wonder-camel from Persian miniatures: a camel whose body is made of many small painted creatures (a fox, birds, a fish, a hare) fitted together in a decorative pattern, flying through the air. Whimsical, joyful, like an old Persian painting.
subjects.PR1-D09: a baby ibex kid with tiny curved horn buds and big eyes, bouncing on a rock with all four hooves off the ground, a little garland of pink almond blossoms around its neck. Sweet and playful.
subjects.PR1-D10: a pari: a winged young woman of Persian folk tales with a serene round face, dark almond eyes, long black hair, a red robe patterned with small white blossoms, a lapis-blue sash with long curling ends, bare feet, and big wings layered in deep green, rust-orange and slate-blue feathers, standing watch on the top of Mount Qaf, a flat stylised mountain made of glowing emerald-green crystal, shading her eyes with one hand and looking out; a small spear with a pennant beside her; the green mountain tints the sky around it.
subjects.PR1-D11: Khangi, a helpful little house fairy of the Chitral valleys: a small, round, cheerful fairy with short stubby wings and an apron, standing on a ladder in an apricot tree, dropping ripe apricots into a woven basket held up by nobody, a bowl of food left out for her on the flat roof below.
subjects.PR1-D12: a shooting star falling across a deep blue night sky that fades into the saffron ground, drawn as a tiny glowing pari with trailing golden hair and a long tail of little gold dots and white stars, diving downwards. Beautiful, not frightening.
subjects.PR1-D13: a mountain gale sweeping down a valley: three paris flying in a row with their sashes streaming, blowing stylised curling wind that bends the poplar trees and sends leaves and petals flying. Dramatic but gentle.
subjects.PR1-D14: a pari: a winged young woman of Persian folk tales with a serene round face, dark almond eyes, long black hair, a red robe patterned with small white blossoms, a lapis-blue sash with long curling ends, bare feet, and big wings layered in deep green, rust-orange and slate-blue feathers, sitting sadly inside a round iron birdcage hanging from the highest branch of a tall tree, as two other paris fly up to her carrying little golden perfume flasks and flowers, fragrant swirls rising from the flasks; she smiles as they arrive. Tender, hopeful, not scary.
subjects.PR1-D15: people and paris marching together to music: a young drummer with a big frame drum and a pari playing a long-necked lute walk side by side, with more paris flying above in step, banners with no writing on them. Joyful and brave.
subjects.PR1-D16: two paris flying through a starry night sky carrying a sleeping girl in a long embroidered dress between them on a floating carpet of cloth, her head resting on a cushion, fast asleep and smiling; a moon and small stars on the saffron-to-indigo sky.
subjects.PR1-D17: Pari Banu's magic tent: a small, beautiful Persian tent of red and gold striped cloth with a lapis-blue fringe, shown unfolding from the palm of a slender hand into a huge pavilion, with tiny people and horses walking into it. Wondrous.
subjects.PR1-D19: Asman Pari, the queen of the paris of Mount Qaf: a regal but kind young pari queen with a tall golden crown, a robe of deep sky-blue with gold stars and white blossoms, and huge wings in green, rust and slate-blue, seated on a floating cloud-throne, raising one hand as a gust of sky wind and little stars sweep outwards from it. Gracious, not severe.
subjects.PR1-K01: a single white dove in flight with a tiny red-and-gold flower crown on its head, wings spread wide, a few slate-blue and green feathers mixed into its white wings. Simple and pretty.

banner: Paristan at the edge of the world: Mount Qāf, a great mountain of emerald on the horizon whose green glow tints the sky, and in front of it a hidden mountain pool framed by flowering almond branches with pink blossoms. On the grass beside the pool lie three coats of feathers, left there by bathers, their layered wing-bands in deep green, rust-orange and slate-blue with white edges. Three white doves perch on a branch. Long lapis-blue ribbons drift through the air.
